$comment: What a plugin reads of a response's body, on both hosts: bodyBase64 is asked for when first read and only during the call that fetched it, and a body over limits.json's responseBodyBytes is RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE, and a call keeps at most unreadBodyBytesPerCall of its unread bodies (kangzj/lantern-tv#333). The calls run in order on one runtime.
